title: Corrective-action close rate
summary: Share of corrective actions registered by the post-incident-review playbook that reach a closed status before their due date in the reporting window. The corrective-action register is the persistence surface behind the corrective-action-tracking step; this KPI is the close-rate side of the same register that the overdue KRI watches as a risk signal. Higher is better.

target.rationale: Programme target on top of NIS2 Art. 21(2)(b) and DORA Art. 19(4)(c) lessons-learned obligations.

measurement.formula: count( actions where status=='closed' AND closed_at <= due_date ) / count( actions in window )

inputs.name: register
inputs.description: operator-owned corrective-action register read at window close

external_refs.name: DORA Article 19(4)(c) — final report lessons learned and action plan
